message: No detected input validation: There are no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on incoming data; the code reads CSVs and Redis blobs directly into DataFrames without any structural validation.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data fetched from the external time-series API (load_ts_prices) and from Redis uses no checksum, signature verification, or pinned revision; only an OAuth access token is used for authentication, with no integrity check on the returned data.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation code applies transformations and drops NaN/inf values but performs no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs to defend against data poisoning.

No detected model integrity verification: No pretrained weights or serialized models are loaded in this code; models are trained in-memory via scikit-learn, and no hash checks, signature verification, or pinned revisions are implemented.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample distributions before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse, activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor defense in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanisms are imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While multiple metrics are computed (accuracy, precision, recall, F1, R2, MSE, etc.), there is no evidence of a held-out test set isolated from training data, signed/hashed evaluation data, or other anti-tampering controls.

No detected input sanitization: The code reads file_id directly from the URL, accesses request.json fields like 'transforms' without schema validation or shape/type checks, and passes them to transform_data and engine functions with no sanitization.
No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs are converted to numpy/JSON and returned without any NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or sanity validation before being sent to the client.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses sklearn ML models (KMeans, KNN, regression, etc.), not LLMs, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
